key_review_items: The original 526-cell-line standalone split files disagree with ZIP assignments for overlapping cell lines
The ZIP includes 492 eligible cell lines; 34 of the original 526 do not appear in the eligible cohort
The ZIP contains GDSC2 response only, no GDSC1
Reported sex labels in the ZIP are not proven to be Natasha final corrected labels
All raw source files and generation algorithm are not included, so regeneration from original sources is not fully reproducible
